preferred_cv_style.pl: Styl profesjonalny, konkretny, C-level, biznesowo-technologiczny. Bez przesadnego marketingu, bez pustych sloganów i bez dopisywania niepotwierdzonych kompetencji. Tekst powinien pokazywać połączenie doświadczenia zarządczego, sprzedażowego, founderskiego, produktowego i technologicznego. W przypadku stanowisk stricte technologicznych należy pozycjonować Tomasza jako lidera biznesowo-technologicznego, operatora i użytkownika narzędzi AI/LLM, a nie jako klasycznego software engineera.
preferred_cv_style.en: Professional, concise, C-level, business-technology oriented style. Avoid excessive marketing language, empty slogans and unsupported claims. The text should show the combination of executive, sales, founder, product and technology experience. For technology-heavy roles, Tomasz should be positioned as a business-technology leader, operator and practical user of AI/LLM tools, not as a traditional software engineer.

llm_guardrails: Do not invent experience, companies, roles, tools, industries, metrics, certifications or achievements not present in the base profile.
Do not present Tomasz as a software engineer, developer or data scientist unless the job description only requires business-level technical understanding.

AI, LLM, GitHub, Python, PostgreSQL, Render, Sanity and API skills must be described as practical business automation and product/workflow prototyping competencies — not senior engineering experience.
When a job requires a skill not directly confirmed in the profile, use adjacent or transferable experience instead of claiming direct expertise.
Use ATS keywords naturally — only when consistent with the base profile.
Maintain credibility for readers with IT, SaaS, sales, finance and executive backgrounds.
Respect character limits: summary max 900 chars, competencies total max 600 chars, each bullet max 200 chars.
Prefer measurable achievements from the profile where available.
Do not add unconfirmed numbers to AI, LLM or outreach automation experience.

Tomasz Uściński has strong business, sales, founder, C-level and technology-commercialization experience. He may use AI, LLMs, GitHub, Python, PostgreSQL, Render, Sanity and API-based tools in practical business workflows, automation and prototyping. Do not describe him as a senior software engineer, backend developer, ML engineer or data engineer unless the base CV explicitly confirms such a role. For IT-oriented job postings, position him as a business-technology leader, AI-enabled sales/process automation practitioner, product/commercial operator and executive who can work effectively with technical teams.
